package.description: A glowing sticky note that floats above every window, with transparent glass and opaque text.

en-US.author: DozenPartsOfTheKing
en-US.description: A glowing sticky note that floats above every window, with transparent glass and opaque text.
en-US.longDescription:
Glo is an always-on-top note for Windows. The glass behind the text can be made anywhere from 0 to 100% transparent while the letters stay fully opaque.
Neon glow around the text in 8 colors, frosted glass, marker mode, tray icon and global hotkeys.
Double-click the note to click through it to the app below.
One portable exe with no dependencies and no network access. UI in English, Russian, Spanish, Chinese and French.
en-US.name: Glo
